tools.name: tiehoy_lote_status
tools.description: Current TIE (foreigner identity card) pickup lote for a Spanish province: the latest lote released at each police office, lotes released this week and last week, the 3-week weekly average, and when it was observed. Optionally filter to one office by name. Returns page links on tiehoy.com.

tools.name: tiehoy_lote_estimate
tools.description: Whether a TIE card with a given lote number is ready for pickup at a specific office. The expected pickup window, its basis and the progress chart are on the linked tiehoy.com page.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "tiehoy_lote_estimate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Whether a TIE card with a given lote number is ready for pickup at a specific office, and if not, the expected pickup window with a confidence level. Returns a link to the full estimate with its basis and progress chart on tiehoy.com." → after: "Whether a TIE card with a given lote number is ready for pickup at a specific office. The expected pickup window, its basis and the progress chart are on the linked tiehoy.com page."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
